name: Seated knee bends
instructions: Sit tall at the edge of a chair, side-on to the camera. Slowly bend your knee as far as is comfortable, then straighten it fully.

name: Standing hip flexion
instructions: Stand side-on, hold a chair for balance, lift your knee towards your chest, then lower it.

name: Elbow curls
instructions: Sit side-on with your arm straight down, curl your forearm up, then lower it slowly.

name: Shoulder raises
instructions: Face the camera, arm at your side, raise it out sideways to shoulder height, then lower it.
